title: CAT7 Memory Record Schema
description: Cognitive Artifact Tier 7 (CAT7) memory record schema per arXiv 2604.19540 Mesh Memory Protocol. Lineage is a linear chain (not DAG) in v3.2.0 — DAG support deferred to v3.3.0 (DR-3 decision).

id.description: Unique identifier for the CAT7 record (UUID or similar)

concept.description: What is being remembered — a short human-readable label for the cognitive artifact

attributes.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs carrying domain-specific metadata for the record

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was created

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp from which the record is considered valid (null = from creation)

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the record expires (null = permanent)

last_accessed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last read/access (null = never accessed)

temporality.description: Temporal metadata governing when the record is valid and when it was last used

source_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that created this record

source_session_id.description: Session identifier in which the record was created

trigger.description: What triggered the creation of this record (e.g. 'task-completion', 'user-feedback')

provenance.description: Provenance tracking to identify which agent and session produced the record

confidence.description: Confidence score [0, 1] indicating how certain the stored knowledge is. Drives tier routing: <0.4 → STM, 0.4–0.79 → MTM, >=0.8 → LTM

lineage.description: Ordered list of prior CAT7 record IDs this record derives from. Linear chain only in v3.2.0 — DAG deferred to v3.3.0 (DR-3: arXiv 2604.19540 §A.3 lineage semantics were ambiguous between linear and DAG; linear chain chosen for simplicity and traceability)

embedding_refs.description: Optional references to pre-computed vector embeddings for semantic recall. Nullable in v3.2.0.

model_name.description: Name/identifier of the embedding model used

vector_id.description: Vector store record ID for the embedding

checksum.description: Checksum of the embedded content to detect staleness
